name: tenants_exchange_rates
description: Read the active tenant's reference currency (null until set), the one its reports total in, and its exchange rates: each converts one unit of from_currency to rate units of to_currency from applies_from on. Reports convert with the rate in force on the date, or the inverse of the reverse pair's; a pair with no rate is an error, never 1.0. Nothing is stored converted. Give exchange_rate_id to read one rate. Refused unless the caller is a tenant admin.
